blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه الطبراني في الكبير واسناده حسن مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٢٦٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Khairah Subahi (RA) says: “I was among the delegation that had come into the presence of the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ gave us (as a gift) sticks of the “Uha” tree to use for miswak on the journey. We said, “O Messenger of Allah! We have sticks of date-palm fronds (to do miswak with), yet we accept your gift and your present.”

blocks.text: Note:- The stick of the “Uha' tree is what is called the miswak stick.
7. Virtues of the Masjid and the Deeds to Do in It

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسجِدَ اللهِ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللهِ وَالْيَوْمِ اْلآخِرِ وَأَقَامَ الصَّلوةَ وَآتَي الزَّكوةَ وَلَمْ يَخْشَ إِلَّا اللهَ قف فَعَسَي أُولئِكَ أَنْ يَّكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Those who maintain the masjids of Allah are (only) those who believe in Allah and the Last Day, establish Salah, give Zakat, and fear none (nothing and no one) but Allah - such people are fit to be among those who are rightly guided.

blocks.text: Explanation: Maintaining the masjid means having all the deeds that took place in the masjid of the Prophet ﷺ take place in one's own masjid as well: inviting towards Iman, holding gatherings that speak about the unseen, the arrival and departure of Jama'ahs, setting up gatherings that encourage people towards deeds, learning knowledge, doing Dhikr,
